settings.label: Award points
settings.help: Off, and the game is played for fun: nobody wins or loses points, the guesses still count for the scoreboards.

settings.label: Win amount
settings.help: Paid for a correct !high or !low in chat. A correct !equal pays double and a wrong !equal costs this amount. A wrong !high or !low costs nothing.

settings.label: Equal chance
settings.help: How often an !equal guess draws the same number again. Every other draw is a free pick from 1 to 100.
The Streamer.bot user variable that winnings are added to and losses taken from. Currency Core by StreamUP is found on its own and overrides this.
What your currency is called in chat; it fills {currency} and {pointsName}. Overridden by Currency Core when it is installed.

settings.label: Guess with channel points
settings.help: Twitch only. Guesses come from the three rewards below, and on Twitch the !high, !low and !equal chat commands do nothing. YouTube and Kick keep playing in chat.

settings.label: Reward ID for high
settings.help: The ID of the custom reward that guesses higher. Redemptions of any other reward are left alone.

settings.label: Reward ID for low
settings.help: The ID of the custom reward that guesses lower.

settings.label: Reward ID for equal
settings.help: The ID of the custom reward that guesses the same number.

settings.label: Stake
settings.help: Cost: the reward's price is the stake. Fixed: the fixed bet below is. Either way the channel points are spent, a correct guess pays the stake in points (double on !equal) and a wrong one costs nothing more. Input: the viewer types a bet in their own points into the redemption (a number, all, half, third, quarter or random); only a wrong !equal takes it. Free: plays like the chat commands with the win amount.

settings.label: Fixed bet
settings.help: The stake in Fixed mode, whatever the reward costs.
Input and Fixed only: bets below this are refused and refunded. 0 turns the floor off.
Input and Fixed only: bets above this are refused and refunded. 0 turns the ceiling off.

settings.label: Refund redemptions that don't play
settings.help: A redemption that ends without a guess (blocked viewer, cooldown, refused bet, error) gets its channel points back. Twitch only refunds while the redemption waits in the request queue, so the rewards must not skip it.

settings.label: Everyone
settings.help: Written onto the command when you save, and kept for the matching reward. 0 turns it off.

settings.label: Outcome
settings.help: Sent after every guess. {pointsSection} reads like ' won 1.234 Points' or ' lost 1.234 Points' and stays empty when no points changed.

settings.default: 🎲 High-Low game started! The current number is {number}. Please type '!high', '!low' or '!equal' to guess whether the next number will be higher, lower, or equal.
settings.label: New round
settings.help: Sent when a moderator runs !highlowsetup. A number is ready from the start, so the game also runs without it.

settings.default: ↩️ @{user}, your channel point redemption was refunded.
settings.label: Redemption refunded
settings.help: Sent when a redemption gets its channel points back. Empty it to refund quietly.

settings.default: @{user}, type how many {pointsName} you want to bet into the redemption.
settings.label: Bet: nothing typed
settings.help: Input mode: the redemption came without a bet.

settings.default: @{user}, '{amount}' is not a bet. Use a number above 0, all, half, third, quarter or random.
settings.label: Bet: not a number
settings.help: Input mode: the typed bet could not be read or is not above zero.

settings.label: Bet: not enough points
settings.help: Input mode: the bet is more than the viewer has.

settings.label: Bet: under the minimum
settings.help: Input and Fixed mode: the bet is below the minimum.

settings.label: Bet: over the maximum
settings.help: Input and Fixed mode: the bet is above the maximum.

settings.help: Sent while a command or reward is on cooldown for the whole chat.

settings.default: @{user}, please wait {seconds} seconds before trying again ⏳
settings.label: A viewer's cooldown
settings.help: Sent while a command or reward is on cooldown for that one viewer.
